title: Noncommutative Fourier Transform for MRI Reconstruction: A Cohomological Approach
content: This paper presents a unified framework that integrates the noncommutative Fourier transform with equivariant cohomology for the analysis and reconstruction of diffusion MRI data. We develop a rigorous mathematical approach that exploits the symmetries of the group SO(3) to optimize high-resolution image reconstruction while ensuring an algorithmic complexity of O(|G| log |G|). Our analysis includes a detailed investigation of numerical stability through differential geometric techniques, resulting in explicit error bounds based on the curvature of representation spaces. The proposed method significantly enhances the accuracy of nerve fiber mapping in cerebral white matter and offers promising perspectives for advanced clinical applications. In bridging abstract mathematical theory with practical medical imaging, this work opens new avenues for high-resolution computational image processing.
